diagnosis: The agent spent almost the whole budget in a bottom-up dependency pass.
Core date, calculation, seed, persistence, store, chart, confetti and form code existed, but no requested screen or product composition had been written.
Template entry code remained while the agent had already replaced template types and UI exports, leaving deterministic TypeScript failures.
Progress narration and a 14-file architecture increased latency for a fixed 20-minute budget.
generalizedChangesForNextIteration: Require a runnable vertical product skeleton and connected entry during the first implementation third.
Prefer 6-10 cohesive files and reuse technical template primitives.
Suppress progress narration and late architectural rewrites.
Use medium reasoning for the implementation pass so more wall time reaches code generation.
